scope: A1-A5 policy authorization, artifact provenance, venue/account binding, instrument selection, and causal day-status persistence

A1.mechanism: authorize_e0_bracket requires a positive selected E0ActionValue with exact policy/action/intent/expiry/decision-set/risk provenance, or a typed E0RuleSelection produced from the actual E0DecisionSet first inward fade under the exact fixed TargetPolicy.

A2.mechanism: Complete positive learned values require typed E0CommittedPredictionEvidence bound to target, fold, feature, model, calibrator, source, and fitted closure identities; all-negative/incomplete controls may abstain without fabricated model evidence.
A2.synthetic_control: E0SyntheticNumericalEvidence is explicit and separate from committed prediction evidence

A3.mechanism: E0OutcomeReplay construction, restore, and append require VenuePath and FillScenario; manifest instrument, source path version, coverage version, fee version, every fill scenario version, and every source event are checked exactly.

A4.mechanism: Instrument is required when source-event binding is present; unknown instruments and accounts with multiple terms are rejected instead of selecting the first term.

A5.mechanism: A day status is admitted only after every actual scheduled fact is known, persisted once at immutable date:final identity, repeated only with an exact payload, and conflicting later payloads require a new ledger version.

reporting_23_field_review.risk_conclusion: No field is treated as a favorable economic claim without the account, order, source, parity, fee, population, and execution-evidence gates.
